purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 542 Konya (city code 5107); city-local registry basis and safe anonymous parcel-geometry access status.
primaryPublisher: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü (TKGM), Konya Cadastre Directorate
registryBasis: The official TKGM Konya regional directory lists Konya Kadastro Müdürlüğü and central Meram Tapu Müdürlüğü. TKGM documents a public parcel/coordinate viewer and states that owner name or Turkish ID cannot be used for public queries. An anonymous exact WUP-point request returned a valid closed Polygon identified administratively as Konya / Meram / Öğretmenevleri; only geometry and a synthetic ID from public parcel keys were retained.

officialSources.observation: Official TKGM Konya Regional Directorate directory lists Konya Cadastre Directorate and central Meram Tapu Directorate.
Official TKGM page describes public parcel, area and coordinate lookup and states owner name/T.C. identity cannot be used as query keys.

Exact anonymous point request using only the ranked WUP coordinate returned a GeoJSON Feature with one Polygon and safe parcel identifiers; source locality was Konya / Meram / Öğretmenevleri. No other response attributes retained.

accessReview.reason: TKGM supports public point identification but the existing adapter is point/exact-ID only and does not enumerate bounded areas. One point sample establishes a public geometry hit at the WUP point, not citywide completeness or runtime readiness. Existing shared provider configuration was not changed.

requestEvidence.observation: Anonymous exact WUP-point request returned Feature/Polygon. Response keys were inspected; owner, account or address fields were not present. Only geometry and a synthetic source ID built from public locality/block/parcel keys were retained.

technicalBlocker: TKGM supports public point identification but the existing adapter is point/exact-ID only and does not enumerate bounded areas. One point sample establishes a public geometry hit at the WUP point, not citywide completeness or runtime readiness. Existing shared provider configuration was not changed.
sampleDisposition: One complete, closed, point-containing Polygon retained as geometry plus a synthetic safe source ID; no other attributes retained.
remainingUncertainty: Area coverage, update vintage, reuse terms for automated access, and polygon integrity outside the one sampled point. No citywide or arbitrary-area enumeration is verified.
rootAssessment: Two bounded production-adapter checks obtained seven distinct public parcel IDs and re-read their full geometries, but nearby point requests repeatedly failed without an HTTP response and a valid-format absence response remained unverified. Independent GEOS audits reproduce invalid geometry in TR-TKGM-128083-812-81 in both source WGS84 and metric coordinates. Konya remains held without repairing or excluding that parcel. Point/exact lookup is a supported source mode; its lack of area enumeration is a scope limit, not the reason for this hold.
